title: A simple week of meals
assistantResponse: A balanced week with simple breakfasts, lunches, and dinners. Adjust portions and ingredients to your household.

breakfast.name: Banana oats
instructions: Combine oats, milk, and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, then top with sliced banana.

lunch.name: Chickpea salad
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas; chop cucumber and tomatoes.
Toss with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.

dinner.name: Tomato pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until just tender.
Cook garlic and tomatoes in olive oil; toss with pasta and top with parmesan and basil.

breakfast.name: Yogurt and berries
instructions: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, granola, and honey.

lunch.name: Egg salad toast
instructions: Boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel, and chop.
Mix with mayonnaise and mustard; serve on toast with chives.

dinner.name: Vegetable curry
instructions: Soften diced onion, then stir in curry paste.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes and fold in spinach. Serve with rice.

breakfast.name: Mushroom toast
instructions: Toast the sourdough.
Cook mushrooms with butter, garlic, thyme, and a pinch of salt; pile onto toast.

lunch.name: Lemon couscous
instructions: Cover couscous with boiling stock and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff and mix with chickpeas, chopped cucumber, parsley, lemon juice, and olive oil.

dinner.name: Roast chicken and vegetables
instructions: Heat oven to 200 C; chop carrots and potatoes and toss with oil and herbs.
Add chicken and roast for 35-40 minutes until cooked through and vegetables are tender.

breakfast.name: Apple cinnamon oats
instructions: Simmer oats, milk, and cinnamon for 5 minutes.
Top with diced apple and walnuts.

lunch.name: Leftover curry bowl
instructions: Warm the curry and rice until steaming.
Serve together with yogurt and chopped cilantro.

dinner.name: Baked salmon and rice
instructions: Cook rice and steam broccoli.
Bake seasoned salmon at 200 C for 12-15 minutes; serve with lemon, rice, and broccoli.

breakfast.name: Avocado toast
instructions: Toast the bread until crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon and salt, spread on toast, and finish with chili flakes.

lunch.name: Tomato soup and bread
instructions: Cook onion until soft, then add tomatoes and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, swirl in cream, and serve with toasted bread.

dinner.name: Tofu rice bowl
instructions: Cook rice and press tofu dry; cube and pan-fry until golden.
Add soy sauce and serve over rice with sliced carrot and cucumber.

breakfast.name: Pancakes
instructions: Whisk flour, egg, milk, and baking powder into a smooth batter.
Cook small portions on a buttered skillet until bubbles form, flip, and serve with syrup.

lunch.name: Roasted vegetable wraps
instructions: Slice vegetables and roast at 220 C for 15 minutes.
Spread hummus on tortillas, add greens and vegetables, then roll tightly.

dinner.name: Bean tacos
instructions: Warm drained beans with cumin and a splash of water.
Fill warm tortillas with beans and avocado; finish with lime juice.

breakfast.name: Fruit and yogurt
instructions: Add yogurt to a bowl.
Top with chopped fruit, seeds, and honey.

lunch.name: Pesto pasta salad
instructions: Cook pasta, drain, and rinse briefly with cool water.
Toss with pesto, tomatoes, spinach, and parmesan; season to taste.

dinner.name: Butternut squash soup
instructions: Roast diced squash at 200 C until tender; soften onion with cumin in a pot.
Add squash and stock, simmer 10 minutes, blend smooth, and stir in coconut milk.
